narrative.summary: feeToSetter() is an OP-stack cross-domain forwarder (CrossChainAccount) that only forwards calls relayed by the L2CrossDomainMessenger from Uniswap’s Ethereum-mainnet Governance Timelock, which enforces a 2-day delay (172,800s) and is administered by GovernorBravo. It is the same forwarder that owns the V3 Factory’s fee adapter, with no Safe and no bare EOA in the chain.
narrative.tag: $89.1M Base TVL, same DAO root as V3 and V4
narrative.detail: Scope is narrow: per the deployed Factory and Pair source, feeToSetter can only call setFeeTo or setFeeToSetter (the V2 protocol-fee switch), with no pool upgrade and no access to LP principal. crossExposureScore 100 is not a claim of independence: V2, V3 and V4 on Base share this one forwarder and L1 Timelock, but DAO-rooted targets are left out of the signer-overlap score.
